landing_title: Every encounter starts with a better connection.
landing_description: Connecting patients and care teams, from pre-registration to triage assessment, with clear information and professional judgment at the heart of every step.
landing_professional_description: AI offers a suggestion. Assessment and triage decisions always remain with the care team.
landing_step1_body: The Android app collects initial information to help the team welcome the patient.
landing_step2_body: Identity is verified and arrival at the site is recorded, connecting the encounter from the start.
landing_step3_body: Nursing captures clinical information. The professional reviews it and makes an independent triage decision.
landing_team_title: Every role, in the right place.
landing_role_reception: Welcome, verify and connect every arrival.
guide_home: This is the Asclepio introduction. Use Staff access to sign in. Below you will find the process steps and team roles.
guide_login: Enter your email and password, then select Sign in. Use Preferences to adjust language, theme or reading options.
guide_reception: The indicators show how many pre-registrations are waiting for confirmation and how many encounters are waiting for triage. The screen updates on its own periodically; use Refresh to check right away. Select a site to filter the indicators and the pre-registrations. Verify identity before confirming arrival. You can reject a pre-registration with a reason or open direct registration.
guide_registration: Search by document or register a new patient. Use the unidentified patient option when needed. Review the site and details before registering arrival.
guide_encounters: Select a site and list filters. Open an encounter to review its details and timeline. Use pagination controls to change pages.
guide_detail: This screen shows encounter details and timeline. If your role allows it, you can cancel it with a reason. The guide does not read patient information.
guide_pending: This feature is pending. Use the main navigation to open the screens available to your role.
guide_queue: This screen summarizes encounters by status: waiting for triage, triaged and in care. Below you will see the most recent encounters; open one to review its details. It updates on its own periodically; use Refresh to check right away. The queue by level and waiting time is not available yet. The guide does not read patient data.
guide_reports: This screen summarizes encounters by status and those waiting for triage at each location. It updates on its own periodically; use Refresh to check right away. Time reports and the CSV download are not available yet. The screen does not show patient data.
